card.name: Dosing frequency wording after a dose
card.fires_on: The comma, space, or small word (once, every, on) right after a dose or route phrase, where the schedule comes next, such as 'once daily,' or 'every' before 3 weeks.

modes.label: Comma after once daily
modes.description: Comma following 'once daily' before a note on timing or food.
modes.example: Take LENVIMA once daily<<,>> with or without food, at the same

modes.label: Every before interval
modes.description: The word or space after 'every' in a dosing schedule, before a number of weeks.
modes.example: on the same day every<< >>3 weeks In combination with cisplatin

modes.label: Once or every after infusion
modes.description: Frequency word following an infusion duration or dose.
modes.example: over 3-5 minutes<< once>> weekly for 6 weeks in 7

card.writes: It prepares time-period words such as weekdays, evenings, and parts of the day.
card.plain: It spots the place in a dosing sentence where the schedule, like once weekly or every 3 weeks, is about to be given.
